build.buildCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt && python manage.py collectstatic --no-input

deploy.startCommand: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py seed_groups && python manage.py ensure_admin && (test "$SEED_DEMO" = "true" && python manage.py seed_demo || true) && gunicorn config.wsgi:application --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT
